label: EVA 2 / LGX Lite / Dragon
source_scope: Mixed-source native modules; source patch version unknown. Each leaf retains its exact native source SHA, occurrence and revision.
notices: Mixed-source EVA 2 native CAD; every leaf retains its source revision, SHA and native occurrence. Patch version unconfirmed.

Three source hole-covering bridge membranes in the Universal face have been removed as instructed by the EVA author after printing. This assembled-view preparation differs from the untouched printable source.

Four complete native 0.25 mm hole-covering bridge membranes in the Dragon face head pockets are removed for assembled viewing. Source outer mating geometry, native screw positions and head-pocket dimensions remain unchanged.
Carriage, Cartesian back, duct, both fans, M8 probe, source shroud, LGX Lite drive and complete X endstop/bracket/fasteners retain their original V-Minion positions.
PTFE retains its original native radial geometry and filament axis; cut ends match the authored hotend seat and retained LGX body socket endpoint.
Hotend face fasteners use the exact current author module occurrences. The two obsolete original face screws are removed.
Source screw/nut and purchased internal threaded contacts are distinguished from unintended body interference. Thread flank clearance and full physical fit are not certified.
Axis values are source CAD offsets, not firmware home coordinates. Reset nozzle CAD parking is outside the positive-Y bed edge.

Public live Onshape modules are linked by the official EVA2 GPLv3 STEP notice, but the same tagged repository LICENSE declares CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Exact applicability to the pinned live Onshape documents is unresolved. Preserve both conflicting notices and source attribution; do not assign the repository license blindly or claim a dual-license grant. Native purchased component rights are not separately inferred from export access.

The two current Dragon assembly M3 face screw occurrences are off the source nut axes by about 0.147 mm. Exact same-author V6 DIN M3x25 native occurrences replace them after measured Dragon-hole/nut axis checks; no screw relocation or generic substitute.

Preview bed Y is limited to 1.5-180 mm: the unchanged source host bolt/idler intersects at CAD Y=0. Exact native separation is 0.17174 mm at Y=1.5 mm. Axis values are CAD offsets, not firmware homing.

The rigid source X switch actuator touches its trigger at X=0. Micrometre rail/block alignment contacts are retained as unqualified native CAD findings; no full physical-fit or continuous-travel certification.
